NeedleError::WorkerScoped { message, worker_id } => {\n447\t                write!(f, \"worker-scoped error (worker {}): {}\", worker_id, message)\n448\t            }\n449\t        }\n450\t {\n566\t    pub worker_id: String,\n567\t    /// Fully-qualified identity of the peer.\n568\t    pub qualified_id: Option<String>,\n569\t    pub pid: u32,\n570\t    pub pid_alive: bool,\n571\t    pub ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n577\t// Emitter loop (runs in a dedicated std::thread)\n578\t// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n579\t\n580\t/// Maximum sleep between heartbeat attempts when backing off on failure.\n581\tconst MAX_HEARTBEAT_BACKOFF: Duration = Duration::from_secs(5 * 60);\n582\t\n583\t/// Sleep interval for interruptible sleep — check shutdown flag every 100ms.\n584\t///\n585\t/// This ensures the heartbeat emitter responds to shutdown signals within 100ms\n586\t/// instead of sleeping for the full heartbeat interval (default 60s). When the\n587\t/// worker is killed (e.g., by the capacity governor), this gives the atexit\n588\t/// handler a better chance to emit worker.stopped telemetry.\n589\tconst INTERRUPTIBLE_SLEEP_INTERVAL: Duration = Duration::from_millis(100);\n590\t\n591\t/// Background emitter loop. Writes heartbeat at each interval.\n592\t///\n593\t/// Circuit breaker: after `max_consecutive_failures` consecutive write failures\n594\t/// the loop sets the shutdown flag and exits so the worker terminates instead of\n595\t/// spinning indefinitely.\n596\t///\n597\t/// Backoff: each consecutive failure doubles the inter-attempt sleep, capped at\n598\t/// [`MAX_HEARTBEAT_BACKOFF`].\n599\t///\n600\t/// Uses an interruptible sleep pattern to respond quickly to shutdown signals.\n601\t#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]\n602\tfn emitter_loop(\n603\t    shared_state: Arc<Mutex<SharedHeartbeatState>>,\n604\t    shutdown: Arc<AtomicBool>,\n605\t    heartbeat_dir: PathBuf,\n606\t    worker_id: String,\n607\t    qualified_id: String,\n608\t    workspace: PathBuf,\n609\t    started_at: DateTime<Utc>,\n610\t    interval: Duration,\n611\t    max_consecutive_failures: u32,\n612\t) {\n613\t    // Ensure the heartbeat directory exists before entering the write loop so\n614\t    // that workers self-recover if ~/.needle/state/heartbeats/ is deleted.\n615\t    if let Err(e) = std::fs::create_dir_all(&heartbeat_dir) {\n616\t        tracing::error!(\n617\t            error = %e,\n618\t            dir = %heartbeat_dir.display(),\n619\t            \"failed to create heartbeat directory\"\n620\t        );\n621\t    }\n622\t\n623\t    let mut consecutive_failures: u32 = 0;\n624\t    let mut current_sleep = interval;\n625\t    let mut elapsed = Duration::ZERO;\n626\t\n627\t    loop {\n628\t        // Interruptible sleep: check shutdown flag every 100ms instead of\n629\t        // sleeping for the full interval. This ensures the emitter responds\n630\t        // to shutdown signals quickly, giving the atexit handler a chance to\n631\t        // emit worker.stopped telemetry even if the process is killed.\n632\t        while elapsed < current_sleep {\n633\t            if shutdown.load(Ordering::SeqCst) {\n634\t                tracing::debug!(worker = %worker_id, \"heartbeat emitter shutting down\");\n635\t                return;\n636\t            }\n637\t            let sleep_dur = std::cmp::min(INTERRUPTIBLE_SLEEP_INTERVAL, current_sleep - elapsed);\n638\t            std::thread::sleep(sleep_dur);\n639\t            elapsed += sleep_dur;\n640\t        }\n641\t        elapsed = Duration::ZERO;\n642\t\n643\t        let (state, current_bead, beads_processed, current_workspace, model) =\n644\t            match shared_state.lock() {\n645\t                Ok(guard) => (\n646\t                    guard.state.clone(),\n647\t                    guard.current_bead.clone(),\n648\t                    guard.beads_processed,\n649\t                    guard.current_workspace.clone(),\n650\t                    guard.model.clone(),\n651\t                ),\n652\t                Err(_) => {\n653\t                    // Mutex poisoned — the main thread panicked. Exit.\n654\t                    tracing::error!(\n655\t                        worker = %worker_id,\n656\t                        \"shared state mutex poisoned, heartbeat emitter exiting\"\n657\t                    );\n658\t                    return;\n659\t                }\n660\t            };\n661\t\n662\t        // Use the current bead's workspace if set, otherwise fall back to home workspace.\n663\t        let effective_workspace = current_workspace.unwrap_or_else(|| workspace.clone());\n664\t\n665\t        let is_idle = state == WorkerState::Exhausted || current_bead.is_none();\n666\t        let current_task = current_bead.as_ref().map(|b| b.to_string());\n667\t\n668\t        let data = HeartbeatData {\n669\t            worker_id: worker_id.clone(),\n670\t            qualified_id: qualified_id.clone(),\n671\t            pid: std::process::id(),\n672\t            state,\n673\t            current_bead,\n674\t Configuration Module\n\n**Worker Configuration** (`src/config/mod.rs`):\n- `max_workers`: Maximum concurrent workers (default 4)\n- `launch_stagger_seconds`: Delay between worker launches (default 2s)\n- `idle_timeout`: Seconds between queue polls when idle (default 60s)\n- `idle_action`: `Wait` or `Exit` when queue empty (default `Wait`)\n- `max_claim_retries`: Maximum claim retries before skipping (default 3)\n- `claim_race_lost_skip`: Consecutive race losses before treating as exhausted (default 5)\n- `building_timeout`: BUILDING state timeout in seconds (default 600s)\n- `cpu_load_warn`: CPU load warning threshold (default 0.8)\n- `memory_free_warn_mb`: Memory warning threshold (default 512 MB)\n\n**Concurrency Limits**:\n- Per-provider limits: `max_concurrent`, `requests_per_minute`\n- Per-model limits override provider settings\n- Rate limiter tracks active workers and enforces limits\n\n**Health Configuration**:\n- `heartbeat_interval_secs`: Heartbeat emission frequency (default 30s)\n- `heartbeat_ttl_secs`: Staleness threshold (default 300s)\n- `heartbeat_dir`: Directory for heartbeat files (default `state/heartbeats`)\n\n## Key Behaviors\n\n**Worker Claim Process**:\n1. shutdown signals within 100ms\n586\t/// instead of sleeping for the full heartbeat interval (default 60s). When the\n587\t/// worker is killed (e.g., by the capacity governor), this gives the atexit\n588\t/// handler a better chance to emit worker.stopped telemetry.\n589\tconst INTERRUPTIBLE_SLEEP_INTERVAL: Duration = Duration::from_millis(100);\n590\t\n591\t/// Background emitter loop. Writes heartbeat at each interval.\n592\t///\n593\t/// Circuit breaker: after `max_consecutive_failures` consecutive write failures\n594\t/// the loop sets the shutdown flag and exits so the worker terminates instead of\n595\t/// spinning indefinitely.\n596\t///\n597\t/// Backoff: each consecutive failure doubles the inter-attempt sleep, capped at\n598\t/// [`MAX_HEARTBEAT_BACKOFF`].\n599\t///\n600\t/// Uses an interruptible sleep pattern to respond quickly to shutdown signals.\n601\t#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]\n602\tfn emitter_loop(\n603\t    shared_state: Arc<Mutex<SharedHeartbeatState>>,\n604\t    shutdown: Arc<AtomicBool>,\n605\t    heartbeat_dir: PathBuf,\n606\t    worker_id: String,\n607\t    qualified_id: String,\n608\t    workspace: PathBuf,\n609\t    started_at: DateTime<Utc>,\n610\t    interval: Duration,\n611\t    max_consecutive_failures: u32,\n612\t) {\n613\t    // Ensure the heartbeat directory exists before entering the write loop so\n614\t    // that workers self-recover if ~/.needle/state/heartbeats/ is deleted.\n615\t    if let Err(e) = std::fs::create_dir_all(&heartbeat_dir) {\n616\t        tracing::error!(\n617\t            error = %e,\n618\t            dir = %heartbeat_dir.display(),\n619\t            \"failed to create heartbeat directory\"\n620\t        );\n621\t    }\n622\t\n623\t    let mut consecutive_failures: u32 = 0;\n624\t    let mut current_sleep = interval;\n625\t    let mut elapsed = Duration::ZERO;\n626\t\n627\t    loop {\n628\t        // Interruptible sleep: check shutdown flag every 100ms instead of\n629\t        // sleeping for the full interval. This ensures the emitter responds\n630\t        // to shutdown signals quickly, giving the atexit handler a chance to\n631\t        // emit worker.stopped telemetry even if the process is killed.\n632\t        while elapsed < current_sleep {\n633\t            if shutdown.load(Ordering::SeqCst) {\n634\t                tracing::debug!(worker = %worker_id, \"heartbeat emitter shutting down\");\n635\t                return;\n636\t            }\n637\t            let sleep_dur = std::cmp::min(INTERRUPTIBLE_SLEEP_INTERVAL, current_sleep - elapsed);\n638\t            std::thread::sleep(sleep_dur);\n639\t            elapsed += sleep_dur;\n640\t        }\n641\t        elapsed = Duration::ZERO;\n642\t\n643\t        let (state, current_bead, beads_processed, current_workspace, model) =\n644\t            match shared_state.lock() {\n645\t                Ok(guard) => (\n646\t                    guard.state.clone(),\n647\t                    guard.current_bead.clone(),\n648\t                    guard.beads_processed,\n649\t                    guard.current_workspace.clone(),\n650\t                    guard.model.clone(),\n651\t                ),\n652\t                Err(_) => {\n653\t                    // Mutex poisoned — the main thread panicked. Exit.\n654\t                    tracing::error!(\n655\t                        worker = %worker_id,\n656\t                        \"shared state mutex poisoned, heartbeat emitter exiting\"\n657\t                    );\n658\t                    return;\n659\t                }\n660\t            };\n661\t\n662\t        // Use the current bead's workspace if set, otherwise fall back to home workspace.\n663\t        let effective_workspace = current_workspace.unwrap_or_else(|| workspace.clone());\n664\t\n665\t        let is_idle = state == WorkerState::Exhausted || current_bead.is_none();\n666\t        let current_task = current_bead.as_ref().map(|b| b.to_string());\n667\t\n668\t        let data = HeartbeatData {\n669\t            worker_id: worker_id.clone(),\n670\t            qualified_id: qualified_id.clone(),\n671\t            pid: std::process::id(),\n672\t            state,\n673\t            current_bead,\n674\t            workspace: effective_workspace,\n675\t            last_heartbeat: Utc::now(),\n676\t            started_at,\n677\t            beads_processed,\n678\t            session: worker_id.clone(),\n679\t            is_idle,\n680\t            current_task,\n681\t            model,\n682\t            heartbeat_file: None,\n683\t        };\n684\t\n685\t        let path = heartbeat_dir.join(format!(\"{}.json\", qualified_id));\n686\t        let tmp_path = path.with_extension(\"json.tmp\");\n687\t\n688\t        let write_result: anyhow::Result<()> = (|| {\n689\t            let json = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&data)?;\n690\t            std::fs::write(&tmp_path, json.as_bytes())?;\n691\t            std::fs::rename(&tmp_path, &path)?;\n692\t            Ok(())\n693\t        })();\n694\t\n695\t        match write_result {\n696\t            Ok(()) => {\n697\t                consecutive_failures = 0;\n698\t                current_sleep = interval;\n699\t            }\n700\t            Err(e) => {\n701\t                consecutive_failures += 1;\n702\t                tracing::error!(\n703\t                    error = %e,\n704\t                    worker = %worker_id,\n705\t                    consecutive_failures,\n706\t                    max = max_consecutive_failures,\n707\t                    \"heartbeat write failed\"\n708\t                );\n709\t                if consecutive_failures >= max_consecutive_failures {\n710\t                    tracing::error!(\n711\t                        worker = %worker_id,\n712\t                        consecutive_failures,\n713\t                        \"heartbeat emitter circuit breaker triggered — worker will shut down\"\n714\t                    );\n715\t                    // Emit a final heartbeat event before shutting down so the\n716\t                    // telemetry log shows the circuit breaker was the cause.\n717\t                    let _ = std::fs::write(\n718\t                        heartbeat_dir.join(format!(\"{}-circuit-breaker.txt\", qualified_id)),\n719\t                        format!(\n720\t                            \"Circuit breaker tripped after {} consecutive heartbeat write failures\\n\\\n721\t                             Worker: {}\\n\\\n722\t                             Qualified ID: {}\\n\\\n723\t                             Last error: {}\\n\\\n724\t                             Timestamp: {}\",\n725\t                            consecutive_failures,\n726\t                            worker_id,\n727\t                            qualified_id,\n728\t                            e,\n729\t                            Utc::now().to_rfc3339()\n730\t                        ),\n731\t                    );\n732\t                    shutdown.store(true, Ordering::SeqCst);\n733\t                    return;\n734\t                }\n735\t                // Exponential backoff to reduce log spam before the circuit breaker fires.\n736\t                current_sleep = current_sleep.saturating_mul(2).min(MAX_HEARTBEAT_BACKOFF);\n737\t            }\n738\t        }\n739\t    }\n740\t}\n741\t\n742\t// is_idle = state == WorkerState::Exhausted || current_bead.is_none();\n        let current_task = current_bead.as_ref().map(|b| b.to_string());\n\n        let data = HeartbeatData {\n            worker_id: self.worker_id.clone(),\n            qualified_id: self.qualified_id.clone(),\n            pid: std::process::id(),\n            state,\n            current_bead,\n            workspace: effective_workspace,\n            last_heartbeat: Utc::now(),\n            started_at: self.started_at,\n            beads_processed,\n            session: self.worker_id.clone(),\n            is_idle,\n            current_task,\n            model,\n            heartbeat_file: None,\n        };\n\n        let path = self.heartbeat_path();\n        let tmp_path = path.with_extension(\"json.tmp\");\n\n        // Auto-create parent directory so that heartbeats self-recover if the\n        // directory is deleted while a worker is running.\n        if let Some(parent) = path.parent() {\n            std::fs::create_dir_all(parent)\n                .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to create heartbeat dir: {}\", parent.display()))?;\n        }\n\n        let json = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&data).context(\"failed to serialize heartbeat\")?;\n        std::fs::write(&tmp_path, json.as_bytes()).with_context(|| {\n            format!(\n                \"failed to write temp heartbeat file: {}\",\n                tmp_path.display()\n            )\n        })?;\n        std::fs::rename(&tmp_path, &path).with_context(|| {\n            format!(\n                \"failed to rename heartbeat file: {} -> {}\",\n                tmp_path.display(),\n                path.display()\n            )\n        })?;\n\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Drop for HealthMonitor {\n    fn drop(&mut self) {\n        // Best-effort: signal the emitter and clean up the heartbeat file.\n        self.stop();\n    }\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// StalePeer\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// A peer worker detected as having a stale heartbeat.\n#[derive(Debug)]\npub struct StalePeer {\n    pub worker_id: String,\n    /// Fully-qualified identity of the peer.\n    pub qualified_id: Option<String>,\n    pub pid: u32,\n    pub pid_alive: bool,\n    pub current_bead: Option<BeadId>,\n    pub last_heartbeat: DateTime<Utc>,\n    pub heartbeat_file: PathBuf,\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Emitter loop (runs in a dedicated std::thread)\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Maximum sleep between heartbeat attempts when backing off on failure.\nconst MAX_HEARTBEAT_BACKOFF: Duration = Duration::from_secs(5 * 60);\n\n/// Sleep interval for interruptible sleep — check shutdown flag every 100ms.\n///\n/// This ensures the heartbeat emitter responds to shutdown signals within 100ms\n/// instead of sleeping for the full heartbeat interval (default 60s). When the\n/// worker is killed (e.g., by the capacity governor), this gives the atexit\n/// handler a better chance to emit worker.stopped telemetry.\nconst INTERRUPTIBLE_SLEEP_INTERVAL: Duration = Duration::from_millis(100);\n\n/// Background emitter loop. Writes heartbeat at each interval.\n///\n/// Circuit breaker: after `max_consecutive_failures` consecutive write failures\n/// the loop sets the shutdown flag and exits so the worker terminates instead of\n/// spinning indefinitely.\n///\n/// Backoff: each consecutive failure doubles the inter-attempt sleep, capped at\n/// [`MAX_HEARTBEAT_BACKOFF`].\n///\n/// Uses an interruptible sleep pattern to respond quickly to shutdown signals.\n#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]\nfn emitter_loop(\n    shared_state: Arc<Mutex<SharedHeartbeatState>>,\n    shutdown: Arc<AtomicBool>,\n    heartbeat_dir: PathBuf,\n    worker_id: String,\n    qualified_id: String,\n    workspace: PathBuf,\n    started_at: DateTime<Utc>,\n    interval: Duration,\n    max_consecutive_failures: u32,\n) {\n    // Ensure the heartbeat directory exists before entering the write loop so\n    // that workers self-recover if ~/.needle/state/heartbeats/ is deleted.\n    if let Err(e) = std::fs::create_dir_all(&heartbeat_dir) {\n        tracing::error!(\n            error = %e,\n            dir = %heartbeat_dir.display(),\n            \"failed to create heartbeat directory\"\n        );\n    }\n\n    let mut consecutive_failures: u32 = 0;\n    let mut current_sleep = interval;\n    let mut elapsed = Duration::ZERO;\n\n    loop {\n        // Interruptible sleep: check shutdown flag every 100ms instead of\n        // sleeping for the full interval. This ensures the emitter responds\n        // to shutdown signals quickly, giving the atexit handler a chance to\n        // emit worker.stopped telemetry even if the process is killed.\n        while elapsed < current_sleep {\n            if shutdown.load(Ordering::SeqCst) {\n                tracing::debug!(worker = %worker_id, \"heartbeat emitter shutting down\");\n                return;\n            }\n            let sleep_dur = std::cmp::min(INTERRUPTIBLE_SLEEP_INTERVAL, current_sleep - elapsed);\n            std::thread::sleep(sleep_dur);\n            elapsed += sleep_dur;\n        }\n        elapsed = Duration::ZERO;\n\n        let (state, current_bead, beads_processed, current_workspace, model) =\n            match shared_state.lock() {\n                Ok(guard) => (\n                    guard.state.clone(),\n                    guard.current_bead.clone(),\n                    guard.beads_processed,\n                    guard.current_workspace.clone(),\n                    guard.model.clone(),\n                ),\n                Err(_) => {\n                    // Mutex poisoned — the main thread panicked. Exit.\n                    tracing::error!(\n                        worker = %worker_id,\n                        \"shared state mutex poisoned, heartbeat emitter exiting\"\n                    );\n                    return;\n                }\n            };\n\n        // Use the current bead's workspace if set, otherwise fall back to home workspace.\n        let effective_workspace = current_workspace.unwrap_or_else(|| workspace.clone());\n\n        let is_idle = state == WorkerState::Exhausted || current_bead.is_none();\n        let current_task = current_bead.as_ref().map(|b| b.to_string());\n\n        let data = HeartbeatData {\n            worker_id: worker_id.clone(),\n            qualified_id: qualified_id.clone(),\n            pid: std::process::id(),\n            state,\n            current_bead,\n            workspace: effective_workspace,\n            last_heartbeat: Utc::now(),\n            started_at,\n            beads_processed,\n            session: worker_id.clone(),\n            is_idle,\n            current_task,\n            model,\n            heartbeat_file: None,\n        };\n\n        let path = heartbeat_dir.join(format!(\"{}.json\", qualified_id));\n        let tmp_path = path.with_extension(\"json.tmp\");\n\n        let write_result: anyhow::Result<()> = (|| {\n            let json = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&data)?;\n            std::fs::write(&tmp_path, json.as_bytes())?;\n            std::fs::rename(&tmp_path, &path)?;\n            Ok(())\n        })();\n\n        match write_result {\n            Ok(()) => {\n                consecutive_failures = 0;\n                current_sleep = interval;\n            }\n            Err(e) => {\n                consecutive_failures += 1;\n                tracing::error!(\n                    error = %e,\n                    worker = %worker_id,\n                    consecutive_failures,\n                    max = max_consecutive_failures,\n                    \"heartbeat write failed\"\n                );\n                if consecutive_failures >= max_consecutive_failures {\n                    tracing::error!(\n                        worker = %worker_id,\n                        consecutive_failures,\n                        \"heartbeat emitter circuit breaker triggered — worker will shut down\"\n                    );\n                    // Emit a final heartbeat event before shutting down so the\n                    // telemetry log shows the circuit breaker was the cause.\n                    let _ = std::fs::write(\n                        heartbeat_dir.join(format!(\"{}-circuit-breaker.txt\", qualified_id)),\n                        format!(\n                            \"Circuit breaker tripped after {} consecutive heartbeat write failures\\n\\\n                             Worker: {}\\n\\\n                             Qualified ID: {}\\n\\\n                             Last error: {}\\n\\\n                             Timestamp: {}\",\n                            consecutive_failures,\n                            worker_id,\n                            qualified_id,\n                            e,\n                            Utc::now().to_rfc3339()\n                        ),\n                    );\n                    shutdown.store(true, Ordering::SeqCst);\n                    return;\n                }\n                // Exponential backoff to reduce log spam before the circuit breaker fires.\n                current_sleep = current_sleep.saturating_mul(2).min(MAX_HEARTBEAT_BACKOFF);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Tests\n// failures:\n    /// the emitter must set the shutdown flag and return rather than looping forever.\n    #[test]\n    fn emitter_exits_after_consecutive_failures() {\n        use = Arc::new(Mutex::new(SharedHeartbeatState {\n            state: WorkerState::Selecting,\n            current_bead: None,\n            beads_processed: 0,\n            current_workspace: None,\n            model: \"claude-sonnet-4\".to_string(),\n        }));\n        let shutdown = Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(false));\n\n        let shutdown_clone = shutdown.clone();\n        let shared_state_clone =                \"claude-cb-test\".to_string(),\n                PathBuf::from(\"/tmp\"),\n                Utc::now(),\n                Duration::from_millis(1),\n                3, // trip after 3          shutdown.load(Ordering::SeqCst),\n            \"shutdown flag must be set after circuit breaker trips\"\n        );\n\n        // Restore permissions so the tempdir can be cleaned up.\n        let _ = std::fs::set_permissions(&hb_dir, std::fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o755));\n    }\n\n    #[tokio::test]\n    async fn heartbeat_path_uses_qualified_id_not_bare_worker_id() {\n        let dir }\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Config Source Tracking\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Where a configuration value originated.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub enum ConfigSource {\n    /// Built-in default value.\n    Default,\n    /// Global config file (`~/.config/needle/config.yaml`).\n    GlobalFile(PathBuf),\n    /// Workspace config file (`.needle.yaml`).\n    WorkspaceFile(PathBuf),\n    /// Environment variable override.\n    EnvVar(String),\n    /// CLI argument override.\n    CliOverride,\n}\n\nimpl std::fmt::Display for ConfigSource {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {\n        match self {\n            ConfigSource::Default => write!(f, \"built-in default\"),\n            ConfigSource::GlobalFile(p) => write!(f, \"{}\", p.display()),\n            ConfigSource::WorkspaceFile(p) => write!(f, \"{}\", p.display()),\n            ConfigSource::EnvVar(name) => write!(f, \"{} env var\", name),\n            ConfigSource::CliOverride => write!(f, \"CLI argument\"),\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// Map of config field paths to their source.\n///\n/// Used by `needle config --dump --show-source` to annotate each value.\npub type SourceMap = BTreeMap<String, ConfigSource>;\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Workspace Overrides\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Subset of configuration that can be overridden per-workspace via `.needle.yaml`.\n///\n/// Only these sections are allowed at the workspace level:\n/// - `agent.default`, `agent.timeout`\n/// - `strands` (weave, pulse, unravel)\n/// - `prompt.*`\n/// - `verification` (legacy) or `gates` (new pluggable system)\n///\n/// Non-overridable sections (worker, limits, health, telemetry) are detected\n/// and produce warnings.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Deserialize)]\npub struct WorkspaceOverrides {\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub agent: Option<WorkspaceAgentOverrides>,\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub strands: Option<WorkspaceStrandsOverrides>,\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub prompt: Option<PromptConfig>,\n    /// Verification commands run after agent success, before accepting closure.\n    /// Legacy format — prefer `gates` for new configurations.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub verification: Option<Vec<String>>,\n    /// Pluggable validation gates.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub gates: Option<Vec<GateConfig>>,\n    /// Workspace identity labels (overridable per-workspace).\n    ///\n    /// Set in `.needle.yaml` under `workspace.labels`. Used for cross-workspace\n    /// skill sharing: skills from Explore workspaces whose labels overlap with\n    /// these labels are injected into prompts alongside local skills.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub workspace: Option<WorkspaceLabelsOverride>,\n}\n\n/// Agent fields overridable at the workspace level.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Deserialize)]\npub struct WorkspaceAgentOverrides {\n    pub default: Option<String>,\n    pub timeout: Option<u64>,\n    pub routing: Option<RoutingConfig>,\n}\n\n/// Strand fields overridable at the workspace level.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Deserialize)]\npub struct WorkspaceStrandsOverrides {\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub weave: Option<serde_yaml::Value>,\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub pulse: Option<serde_yaml::Value>,\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub unravel: Option<serde_yaml::Value>,\n}\n\n/// Non-overridable top-level keys in workspace config.\n///\n/// Note: `workspace` is intentionally absent — `workspace.labels` IS overridable\n/// per-workspace. The path fields (`default`, `home`) are simply ignored if set.\nconst NON_OVERRIDABLE_KEYS: &[&str] = &[\"worker\", \"limits\", \"health\", \"telemetry\"];\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Top-level Config\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Fully resolved NEEDLE configuration.\n///\n/// Loaded once at boot, immutable during a session.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct Config {\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub #[serde(default)]\n    pub telemetry: TelemetryConfig,\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub prompt: PromptConfig,\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub health: HealthConfig,\n    /// Provider/model concurrency #[serde(default)]\n    pub gates: Vec<GateConfig>,\n    /// Self-modification (hot-reload) configuration.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub self_modification: SelfModificationConfig,\n    /// FABRIC live dashboard forwarding.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub fabric: FabricConfig,\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Config validation\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// A single config validation error.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct ConfigError {\n    /// Dot-separated field path (e.g., `agent.default`).\n    pub field: String,\n    /// Human-readable explanation.\n    pub message: String,\n}\n\nimpl std::fmt::Display for ConfigError {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {\n        write!(f, \"{}: {}\", self.field, self.message)\n    }\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// CLI overrides\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// CLI-level overrides applied after all file-based config loading.\n#[derive(Debug, Default)]\npub struct CliOverrides {\n    pub workspace: Option<PathBuf>,\n    pub worker_name: Option<String>,\n    pub agent_binary: Option<String>,\n    pub max_workers: Option<u32>,\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// ConfigLoader\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Loads and validates NEEDLE configuration.\npub struct ConfigLoader;\n\nimpl ConfigLoader {\n    /// Load global config from `~/.config/needle/config.yaml`.\n    ///\n    /// If the file does not exist, returns the default config (not an error).\n    pub fn load_global() -> Result<Config> {\n        let path = dirs_or_home(\".config/needle/config.yaml\");\n        Self::load_from_path(&path)\n    }\n\n    /// Load config from a specific path.\n    ///\n    /// If the file does not exist, returns the default config.\n    pub fn load_from_path(path: &Path) -> Result<Config> {\n        if !path.exists() {\n            return Ok(Config::default());\n        }\n        let text = std::fs::read_to_string(path)\n            .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to read config file: {}\", path.display()))?;\n        let config: Config = serde_yaml::from_str(&text)\n            .with_context(|| format!(\"invalid YAML in config file: {}\", path.display()))?;\n        Ok(config)\n    }\n\n    /// Load workspace overrides from `.needle.yaml` in the given workspace root.\n    ///\n    /// Returns `None` if the file does not exist. Emits warnings for\n    /// non-overridable keys found in the workspace config.\n    pub fn load_workspace(workspace_root: &Path) -> Result<Option<WorkspaceOverrides>> {\n        let path = workspace_root.join(\".needle.yaml\");\n        if !path.exists() {\n            return Ok(None);\n        }\n        let text = std::fs::read_to_string(&path)\n            .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to read workspace config: {}\", path.display()))?;\n\n        // Check for non-overridable keys and warn.\n        Self::warn_non_overridable_keys(&text, &path)?;\n\n        let overrides: WorkspaceOverrides = serde_yaml::from_str(&text)\n            .with_context(|| format!(\"invalid YAML in workspace config: {}\", path.display()))?;\n        Ok(Some(overrides))\n    }\n\n    /// Warn about non-overridable top-level keys in workspace config YAML.\n    fn warn_non_overridable_keys(yaml_text: &str, path: &Path) -> Result<()> {\n        let value: serde_yaml::Value = serde_yaml::from_str(yaml_text)\n            .with_context(|| format!(\"invalid YAML in workspace config: {}\", path.display()))?;\n\n        if let serde_yaml::Value::Mapping(map) = value {\n            for key in map.keys() {\n                if let serde_yaml::Value::String(key_str) = key {\n                    if NON_OVERRIDABLE_KEYS.contains(&key_str.as_str()) {\n                        tracing::warn!(\n                            key = %key_str,\n                            path = %path.display(),\n                            \"workspace config contains non-overridable setting '{}' — ignored\",\n                            key_str,\n                        );\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Apply workspace overrides to a config.\n    ///\n    /// Only overridable fields are applied. Records sources in the source map.\n    pub fn apply_workspace(\n        config: &mut Config,\n        overrides: &WorkspaceOverrides,\n        ws_path: &Path,\n        sources: &mut SourceMap,\n    ) {\n        let source = ConfigSource::WorkspaceFile(ws_path.join(\".needle.yaml\"));\n\n        if let Some(ref agent) = overrides.agent {\n            if let Some(ref default) = agent.default {\n                config.agent.default = default.clone();\n                sources.insert(\"agent.default\".to_string(), source.clone());\n            }\n            if let Some(timeout) = agent.timeout {\n                config.agent.timeout = timeout;\n                sources.insert(\"agent.timeout\".to_string(), source.clone());\n            }\n            if let Some(ref routing) = agent.routing {\n                config.agent.routing = Some(routing.clone());\n                sources.insert(\"agent.routing\".to_string(), source.clone());\n            }\n        }\n\n        if let Some(ref strands) = overrides.strands {\n            if let Some(ref weave_val) = strands.weave {\n                if let Ok(weave_cfg) = serde_yaml::from_value::<WeaveConfig>(weave_val.clone()) {\n                    config.strands.weave = weave_cfg;\n                }\n                sources.insert(\"strands.weave\".to_string(), source.clone());\n            }\n            if let Some(ref pulse_val) = strands.pulse {\n                if let Ok(pulse_cfg) = serde_yaml::from_value::<PulseConfig>(pulse_val.clone()) {\n                    config.strands.pulse = pulse_cfg;\n                }\n                sources.insert(\"strands.pulse\".to_string(), source.clone());\n            }\n            if let Some(ref unravel_val) = strands.unravel {\n                if let Ok(unravel_cfg) =\n                    serde_yaml::from_value::<UnravelConfig>(unravel_val.clone())\n                {\n                    config.strands.unravel = unravel_cfg;\n                }\n                sources.insert(\"strands.unravel\".to_string(), source.clone());\n            }\n        }\n\n        if let Some(ref prompt) = overrides.prompt {\n            config.prompt = prompt.clone();\n When both conditions are met, it spawns a new worker subject to the concurrency\n//! cap and backoff to prevent rapid spawn/unspawn cycles.\n//!\n//! This is an opt-in daemon mode — the main `needle run` fleet respects exhaustion\n//! and exits when idle. The supervisor is for always-on fleets that want to pick\n//! up newly-added beads without manual intervention.\n//!\n//! Depends on: `config`, `health`, `types`, `telemetry`.\n\nuse std::path::{Path, PathBuf};\nuse std::process::Command;\nuse std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, AtomicU32, Ordering};\nuse std::sync::Arc;\nuse std::time::{Duration, Instant};\n\nuse anyhow::{Context, Result};\nuse chrono::{DateTime, Utc};\n\nuse crate::config::Config;\nuse crate::health::{HeartbeatData, HealthMonitor};\nuse crate::telemetry::Telemetry;\nuse crate::types::{BeadId, WorkerState};\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Supervisor configuration\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Supervisor configuration derived from global config.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct SupervisorConfig {\n    /// Interval between queue polls when fleet is active (seconds).\n    ///\n    /// When workers are actively processing beads, the supervisor polls at this\n    /// interval to detect when the fleet goes idle.\n    pub poll_interval_active_secs: u64,\n\n    /// Interval between queue polls when fleet is idle (seconds).\n    ///\n    /// When all workers are exhausted, the supervisor polls at this longer\n    /// interval to detect newly-added ready beads.\n    pub poll_interval_idle_secs: u64,\n\n    /// Maximum workers to spawn (concurrency cap).\n    ///\n    /// The supervisor will not spawn workers beyond this cap, even if ready\n    /// beads exist. .unwrap_or_else(|| PathBuf::from(\"state/heartbeats\"));\n        let heartbeat_dir = config.workspace.home.join(&heartbeat_dir);\n\n        SupervisorConfig {\n            poll_interval_active_secs: 10,\n            poll_interval_idle_secs: 30,\n            max_workers: config.worker.max_workers,\n            spawn_backoff_secs: 60,\n            heartbeat_dir,\n            workspace: config.workspace.default.clone(),\n            needle_binary: PathBuf::from(\"needle\"),\n            worker_args: Vec::new(),\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n//   /// Number of idle workers (exhausted or no current bead).\n    pub idle_count: usize,\n\n    /// Number of workers currently processing beads.\n    pub busy_count: usize,\n\n    /// Whether all            busy_count: 0,\n            is_idle: true,\n            active_workers: Vec::new(),\n            computed_at: Utc::now(),\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Ready queue result\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Result Supervisor\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Fleet supervisor: monitors ready queue and heartbeats, spawns workers.\n///\n/// The supervisor runs in a loop, polling the ready queue and reading heartbeat\n/// files to decide when to spawn new workers. It respects the concurrency cap\n/// and implements backoff to prevent rapid spawn/unspawn cycles.\npub struct Supervisor {\n    config: SupervisorConfig,\n    telemetry: Telemetry,\n    shutdown: Arc<AtomicBool>,\n    /// Last time a worker was spawned (for backoff).\n    last_spawn: Arc<Mutex<Instant>>,\n    /// Total workers spawned by this supervisor (for metrics).\n    workers_spawned: Arc<AtomicU32>,\n}\n\nuse std::sync::Mutex;\n\nimpl Supervisor {\n    /// Create a new supervisor.\n    ///\n    /// # Arguments\n    ///\n    /// * `config` - Supervisor configuration\n    /// * `telemetry` - Telemetry emitter\n    /// * `shutdown` - Shared shutdown flag (set by signal handlers)\n    pub fn new(\n        config: SupervisorConfig,\n        telemetry: Telemetry,\n        shutdown: Arc<AtomicBool>,\n    ) -> Self {\n        Supervisor {\n            config,\n            telemetry,\n            shutdown,\n            last_spawn: Arc::new(Mutex::new(Instant::now() - Duration::from_secs(3600))),\n            workers_spawned: Arc::new(AtomicU32::new(0)),\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Run the supervisor main loop.\n    ///\n    /// This method runs until the shutdown flag is set. It polls the ready queue\n    /// and heartbeat files at the configured intervals, spawning workers when:\n    ///\n    /// 1. Ready beads exist in the queue\n    /// 2. Fleet is idle (all workers exhausted or no active workers)\n    /// 3. Active worker count is below the cap\n    /// 4. Backoff period has elapsed since last spawn\n    ///\n    /// # Errors\n    ///\n    /// Returns an error if:\n    /// - The heartbeat directory cannot be read\n    /// - The ready queue check fails\n    /// - A worker cannot be spawned\n    pub async fn run(&self) -> Result<()> {\n        self.telemetry.emit(\n            crate::telemetry::EventKind::SupervisorStarted,\n            [(\"config\", format!(\"{:?}\", self.config))].into_iter().collect(),\n        );\n\n        let mut consecutive_empty_cycles = 0u32;\n        let heartbeat_ttl = Duration::from_secs(300); // 5 minutes default TTL\n\n        loop {\n            if self.shutdown.load(Ordering::Relaxed) {\n                tracing::info!(\"shutdown flag set, supervisor exiting\");\n                self.telemetry.emit(\n                    crate::telemetry::EventKind::SupervisorStopped,\n                    [(\"reason\", \"shutdown_flag\")].into_iter().collect(),\n                );\n                break;\n            }\n\n            // Get current fleet state from heartbeats\n            let fleet = self.get_fleet_state(heartbeat_ttl).await?;\n\n            // Check the ready queue\n            let queue = self.check_ready_queue().await?;\n\n            tracing::debug!(\n                active = fleet.active_count,\n                idle = fleet.idle_count,\n                busy = fleet.busy_count,\n                ready = queue.ready_count,\n                \"supervisor cycle\"\n            );\n\n            // Decide whether to spawn a worker\n            let should_spawn = self.should_spawn(&queue, &fleet);\n\n            if should_spawn {\n                match self.spawn_worker().await {\n                    Ok(_) => {\n                        let spawned = self.workers_spawned.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed) + 1;\n                        tracing::info!(\n                            ready = queue.ready_count,\n                            total_spawned = spawned,\n                            \"supervisor spawned worker\"\n                        );\n                        self.telemetry.emit(\n                            crate::telemetry::EventKind::SupervisorWorkerSpawned,\n                            [\n                                (\"ready_count\", queue.ready_count.to_string()),\n                                (\"total_spawned\", spawned.to_string()),\n                            ]\n                            .into_iter()\n                            .collect(),\n                        );\n                        consecutive_empty_cycles = 0;\n                    }\n                    Err(e) => {\n                        tracing::error!(error = %e, \"failed to spawn worker\");\n                        self.telemetry.emit(\n                            crate::telemetry::EventKind::SupervisorSpawnFailed,\n                            [(\"error\", e.to_string())].into_iter().collect(),\n                        );\n                    }\n                }\n            } else {\n                // Track consecutive empty cycles for adaptive polling\n                if queue.ready_count == 0 && fleet.is_idle {\n                    consecutive_empty_cycles =\n                        consecutive_empty_cycles.saturating_add(1);\n                } else {\n                    consecutive_empty_cycles = 0;\n                }\n            }\n\n            // Adaptive polling: poll faster when active, slower when idle\n            let poll_interval = if fleet.is_idle && queue.ready_count == 0 {\n                // Idle fleet, no work: poll slowly\n                Duration::from_secs(self.config.poll_interval_idle_secs)\n            } else {\n                // Active fleet or work available: poll more frequently\n                Duration::from_secs(self.config.poll_interval_active_secs)\n            };\n\n            // Sleep with interruption check\n            let sleep_start = Instant::now();\n            while sleep_start.elapsed() < poll_interval {\n                if self.shutdown.load(Ordering::Relaxed) {\n                    break;\n                }\n                tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(100)).await;\n            }\n\n            // Emit periodic status telemetry\n            if consecutive_empty_cycles > 0 && consecutive_empty_cycles % 10 == 0 {\n                self.telemetry.emit(\n                    crate::telemetry::EventKind::SupervisorIdleCycle,\n                    [\n                        (\"consecutive_empty\", consecutive_empty_cycles.to_string()),\n                        (\"fleet_idle\", fleet.is_idle.to_string()),\n                    ]\n                    .into_iter()\n                    .collect(),\n                );\n            }\n        }\n\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Check the ready queue for beads.\n    ///\n    /// Runs `br ready --json` and parses the output to count ready beads.\n    async fn check_ready_queue(&self) -> Result<ReadyQueueState> {\n        let output = tokio::process::Command::new(\"br\")\n            .args([\"ready\", \"--json\"])\n            .current_dir(&self.config.workspace)\n            .output()\n            .await\n            .context(\"failed to run 'br ready --json'\")?;\n\n        if !output.status.success() {\n            let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr);\n            return Err(anyhow::anyhow!(\n                \"'br ready --json' failed: {}\",\n                stderr\n            ));\n        }\n\n        let stdout = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout);\n        let beads: Vec<BeadId> = stdout\n            .lines()\n            .filter(|line| !line.is_empty())\n            .filter_map(|line| serde_json::from_str::<BeadId>(line).ok())\n            .collect();\n\n        Ok(ReadyQueueState {\n            ready_count: beads.len(),\n            ready_beads: beads,\n            checked_at: Utc::now(),\n        })\n    }\n\n    /// Get fleet state from heartbeat files.\n    ///\n    /// Reads heartbeat files from the configured directory and computes the\n    /// fleet state (active, idle, busy workers). Stale heartbeats are filtered\n    /// out based on the TTL.\n    async fn get_fleet_state(&self, ttl: Duration) -> Result<FleetState> {\n        let heartbeats = HealthMonitor::read_all_heartbeats(&self.config.heartbeat_dir)?;\n\n        let now = Utc::now();\n        let mut active_workers = Vec::new();\n        let mut idle_count = 0usize;\n        let mut busy_count = 0usize;\n\n        for hb in heartbeats {\n            // Skip stale heartbeats\n            let age = now\n                .signed_duration_since(hb.last_heartbeat)\n                .to_std()\n                .unwrap_or(Duration::ZERO);\n            if age > ttl {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            // Check if PID is alive\n            if !HealthMonitor::check_pid_alive(hb.pid) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            active_workers.push(hb.qualified_id.clone());\n\n            // Count idle vs busy workers\n            // A worker is idle if it's exhausted or has no current bead\n            let is_idle = hb.is_idle || hb.current_bead.is_none();\n            if is_idle {\n                idle_count += 1;\n            } else {\n                busy_count += 1;\n            }\n        }\n\n        let active_count = active_workers.len();\n        let is_idle = active_count == 0 || idle_count == active_count;\n\n        Ok(FleetState {\n            active_count,\n            idle_count,\n            busy_count,\n            is_idle,\n            active_workers,\n            computed_at: now,\n        })\n    }\n\n    /// Decide whether to spawn a worker.\n    ///\n    /// Returns true if all conditions are met:\n    /// 1. Ready beads exist in the queue\n    /// 2. Fleet is idle (all workers exhausted or no active workers)\n    /// 3. Active worker count is below the cap\n    /// 4. Backoff period has elapsed since last spawn\n    fn should_spawn(&self, queue: &ReadyQueueState, fleet: &FleetState) -> bool {\n        // Condition 1: Ready beads must exist\n        if queue.ready_count == 0 {\n            tracing::debug!(\"no ready beads, skipping spawn\");\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        // Condition 2: Fleet must be idle (all workers exhausted)\n        if !fleet.is_idle {\n            tracing::debug!(\n                idle = fleet.idle_count,\n                active = fleet.active_count,\n                \"fleet not idle, skipping spawn\"\n            );\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        // Condition 3: Must be below the worker cap\n        if fleet.active_count >= self.config.max_workers as usize {\n            tracing::debug!(\n                active = fleet.active_count,\n                cap = self.config.max_workers,\n                \"at worker cap, skipping spawn\"\n            );\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        // Condition 4: Backoff period must have elapsed\n        let last_spawn_guard = self.last_spawn.lock().unwrap();\n        let since_last_spawn = last_spawn_guard.elapsed();\n        drop(last_spawn_guard);\n\n        let backoff = Duration::from_secs(self.config.spawn_backoff_secs);\n        if since_last_spawn < backoff {\n            tracing::debug!(\n                since_last_secs = since_last_spawn.as_secs(),\n                backoff_secs = backoff.as_secs(),\n                \"in backoff period, skipping spawn\"\n            );\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        tracing::info!(\n            ready = queue.ready_count,\n            active = fleet.active_count,\n            cap = self.config.max_workers,\n            \"conditions met, will spawn worker\"\n        );\n        true\n    }\n\n    /// Spawn a new worker.\n    ///\n    /// Runs `needle run` in the background as a detached process.\n    async fn spawn_worker(&self) -> Result<()> {\n        // Update last spawn time\n        {\n            let mut last_spawn = self.last_spawn.lock().unwrap();\n            *last_spawn = Instant::now();\n        }\n\n        // Build the command\n        let mut cmd = Command::new(&self.config.needle_binary);\n        cmd.arg(\"run\")\n            .current_dir(&self.config.workspace)\n            .args(&self.config.worker_args);\n\n        tracing::debug!(\n            binary = %self.config.needle_binary.display(),\n            workspace = %self.config.workspace.display(),\n            args = ?self.config.worker_args,\n            \"spawning worker\"\n        );\n\n        // Spawn the process\n        #[cfg(unix)]\n        {\n            use std::os::unix::process::CommandExt;\n            unsafe {\n                cmd.pre_exec(|| {\n                    // Detach from parent process group\n                    // This ensures the worker continues running even if the supervisor dies\n                    Ok(())\n                });\n            }\n        }\n\n        let child = cmd\n            .spawn()\n            .context(format!(\"failed to spawn worker: {:?}\", cmd))?;\n\n        // Let the process run in the background\n        tracing::debug!(pid = child.id(), \"worker spawned\");\n\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\n// Depends on: `types`.\n\nuse std::path::{Path, PathBuf};\nuse std::sync::atomic::{AtomicU64, Ordering};\nuse std::sync::Arc;\n\nuse anyhow::{Context, Result};\nuse chrono::{DateTime, Utc};\nuse serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};\nuse tokio::sync::mpsc;\n\nuse crate::config::{ColorMode, HookConfig, StdoutFormat, StdoutSinkConfig, TelemetryConfig};\nuse crate::types::{BeadId, WorkerId, WorkerState};\n\n// ─── OTLP Sink (feature-gated) ───────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n#[cfg(feature = \"otlp\")]\npub mod otlp;\n\n#[cfg(feature = \"otlp\")]\npub use otlp::{create_tracing_layer, OtlpSink};\n\n// ─── Test Utilities ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n#[cfg(test)]\npub mod test_utils;\n\n// ─── TelemetryEvent ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// A single structured telemetry record.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct TelemetryEvent {\n    /// UTC timestamp with millisecond precision.\n    pub timestamp: DateTime<Utc>,\n    /// Discriminant string, e.g. `\"state_transition\"`.\n    pub event_type: String,\n    /// The worker that emitted this event.\n    pub worker_id: WorkerId,\n    /// Session identifier (8 hex chars, unique per worker boot).\n    pub session_id: String,\n    /// Monotonically increasing counter within the session.\n    pub sequence: u64,\n    /// Bead context when relevant.\n    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = \"Option::is_none\")]\n    pub bead_id: Option<BeadId>,\n    /// Workspace directory when relevant.\n    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = \"Option::is_none\")]\n    pub workspace: Option<PathBuf>,\n    /// Event-specific payload as a JSON value.\n    pub data: serde_json::Value,\n    /// Optional duration in milliseconds for timed operations.\n    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = \"Option::is_none\")]\n    pub duration_ms: Option<u64>,\n    /// W3C trace-id hex (32 lowercase hex chars).
